meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装上本地监控仪表盘:安装 npm 包、复制 pusher 模块、在 src/index.ts 的 main() 里加启动代码、配置 .env、构建测试并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘,或运行 /add-dashboard 时触发。

say.text: 确认仪表盘已在 3100 端口跑起来

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw: adds the @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard package, copies a pusher module, adds a startDashboard() block to main() in src/index.ts, sets .env vars, then builds, tests and restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw or run /add-dashboard.
